title: The Works: tier 7, The signal
lines: Tier 7 is open. Star crystal is found in the outer plots. A gatherer on it gets one every 75 seconds at best.
A grower makes 3 star crystals from 2, with crystal feed. Send 2 of every 3 back into it.

more.head: New
points: Crystal feed, lattices, dishes and the Star folio.
Research lets a tunnel pass under 32 tiles.

more.head: Fixed
points: A machine sending into a full, shut crate now says it has stopped. It shows in Trouble.
